Private Function Snapshot(ByVal wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, c As Range, s As String
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets
        s = s & "~" & ws.Name & ":" & ws.Columns(1).ColumnWidth
        For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C3")
            s = s & ";" & c.Formula & "," & c.NumberFormat & "," & c.Font.Bold & "," & c.Interior.Color
        Next
    Next
    Snapshot = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets(1).Name = "Sheet1"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(1)).Name = "Sheet2"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(2)).Name = "Sheet3"
    With wb.Worksheets("Sheet1")
        .Range("A1").Value = 1
        .Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        .Range("A2").Value = "text"
        .Range("B2").Value = 0.5
        .Range("B2").NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        .Range("A1").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("A2").Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 0)
        .Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 20
    End With
    With wb.Worksheets("Sheet2")
        .Range("A1:C3").Value = "old"
        .Range("C3").Font.Bold = True
        .Range("B2").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
    End With
    wb.Worksheets("Sheet3").Range("A1").Value = 99
    wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Activate
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 1: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), xlFillWithAll
    Case 2: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), xlFillWithContents
    Case 3: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), xlFillWithFormats
    Case 4: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2", "Sheet3")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 5: wb.Worksheets.FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 6: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet2", "Sheet3")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 7: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet2").Range("A1:C3")
    Case 8: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 9: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:A2,B1")
    Case 10: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), 9
    Case 11: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1")
    Case 12: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("C3")
    Case 13: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet3", "Sheet1")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2")
    Case 14: wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), "x"
    End Select
    Tried = Snapshot(wb)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description & "~" & Snapshot(wb)
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 14
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

End Sub

Private sink As FillSink

Public Function Events() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String, wasOn As Boolean, t As Variant
    wasOn = Application.EnableEvents
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For Each t In Array(xlFillWithAll, xlFillWithContents, xlFillWithFormats)
        Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
        wb.Worksheets(1).Name = "Sheet1"
        wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(1)).Name = "Sheet2"
        wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(2)).Name = "Sheet3"
        wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Activate
        wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2").Value = 1
        wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("D4").Select
        Set sink = New FillSink
        Set sink.App = Application
        wb.Sheets(Array("Sheet1", "Sheet2", "Sheet3")).FillAcrossSheets wb.Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:B2"), t
        s = s & "#" & t & ":" & sink.Log & " active " & ActiveSheet.Name & " selection " & Selection.Address(False, False)
        Set sink.App = Nothing
        Set sink = Nothing
        wb.Close False
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.EnableEvents = wasOn
    Events = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
